title: 1 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 21
description: Ten questions on 1 Samuel 21: David at Nob with Ahimelech the priest and his flight to Achish of Gath.

questions.text: To which priest did David come at Nob?
questions.explanation: David came to Nob to Ahimelech the priest, who came to meet him trembling.

questions.text: How many loaves of bread did David ask the priest for?
questions.explanation: David said, "Please give me five loaves of bread in my hand, or whatever is available."

questions.text: What kind of bread did the priest say he had?
questions.explanation: The priest said, "I have no common bread, but there is holy bread."

questions.text: Which servant of Saul was at Nob that day?
questions.explanation: Doeg the Edomite, the best of Saul's herdsmen, was there that day, detained before Yahweh.

questions.text: Why did David say he had not brought his sword or weapons?
questions.explanation: David said he had not brought his sword or his weapons because the king's business required haste.

answers.text: Saul had taken them from him
He had lost them in battle
He had given them to Jonathan

questions.text: Where was the sword of Goliath kept?
questions.explanation: The priest said the sword of Goliath was there, wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod.

answers.text: Wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod

questions.text: To whom did David flee that day for fear of Saul?
questions.explanation: David fled that day for fear of Saul and went to Achish the king of Gath.

questions.text: What did the servants of Achish call David?
questions.explanation: The servants of Achish said, "Isn't this David the king of the land?"

questions.text: What did David do when he pretended to be insane?
questions.explanation: David scribbled on the doors of the gate and let his spittle fall down on his beard.

answers.text: Scribbled on the gate doors and drooled on his beard
Tore his clothes and threw dust in the air
Sat silently in ashes for three days

questions.text: What did Achish ask his servants about David?
questions.explanation: Achish asked, "Do I lack madmen, that you have brought this fellow to play the madman in my presence?"
